### Changed
- When an update is available, the tray icon shows a green dot and a dialog asks once whether to update now. "Yes" installs it right away; "No" keeps the dot and a "● Update now" item in the tray menu for later.
- "Check for updates" in the tray now always answers: it offers the update, says you have the latest version, or reports a failed check with a Retry button.
- The tray tooltip shows the available version and the download progress.
- If an update download fails, the same update stays offered so you can try again.
